section_summary.extract_value: The Discussion reports results from a single study using the BAS in Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), finding a two-factor structure for Malaysian women: General Body Appreciation and Body Image Investment, with similar factor structure across Malay and Chinese women. The authors note General Body Appreciation was significantly negatively correlated with BMI and caution against using a single overall BAS score across cultural groups, recommending using the General Body Appreciation factor for Malay-speaking samples and further research with more representative samples and male participants.

section_summary.extract_value: This discussion reports a validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a Malaysian sample and finds a two-factor structure (General Body Appreciation and Body Image Investment) that differs from the unidimensional structure found in Western samples. General Body Appreciation was significantly negatively associated with BMI, and no significant ethnic differences were found between Malay and Chinese women; the authors caution against using a single overall BAS score across cultures and recommend using the items loading on General Body Appreciation for Malay-speaking populations.
